node.title: hex numbers
node.author: LloydRice
node.doctext: I'm trying to do something that is probably stupidly simple, but it's just not working. I have a string with some decimal digits and some uppercase A..F. The string does NOT begin with "0X". I am simply trying to get the hex value into a variable. I've tried various prefixes, sprintf with various formats, pack, unpack, and a few more things. It's just not working ???
